description.value: Social 242 Lounge & Grill is a full-service lounge and restaurant in downtown Kelowna offering wings in 26 flavours, AAA steaks, and a creative cocktail program with signature and seasonal drinks. The venue also features a dedicated vegan menu and gluten-free options throughout, catering to a wide range of dietary needs. Its central Lawrence Avenue location makes it a convenient food-and-drink stop for cyclists exploring the Okanagan.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (secure) at 95m; lockers (secure) at 96m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and provides address, phone, and menu details confirming an active restaurant at 242 Lawrence Avenue, Kelowna. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those are null. The dedicated Vegan Menu subpage and widespread GFO notations confirm vegan/GF options; the homepage phrase 'FOR PICK UP PLEASE CALL 778-484-0242' confirms takeout availability.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone number; both sourced from website only.
Website shows internally inconsistent operating information across two different page sections, suggesting the site may not be fully current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate full-service restaurant and lounge in downtown Kelowna with a broad menu including vegan and gluten-free options and confirmed takeout service — a solid Food & Drink listing for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated Vegan Menu subpage with multiple vegan dishes including Cauli Wings, Chickn' Parm, and Alfredo Mac N Cheeze. Main menu widely annotated with GFO (gluten free option available)
